set +e
show() { grep -n -B8 -A3 "$1" $2 | head -40; echo ----; }
echo "#### FreeTypeOt stubs"; for n in L1uHkWTazkI dojyaLKzKN0 3WpTQrvGUcU 0Aal-TIC4so ++lgV9pRsO4; do show "\"$n\"" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/Export.cpp; done

grep -n "NotImplemented" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/Export.cpp | wc -l
grep -n "APS5_EXPORT" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/Export.cpp | wc -l
ls core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/* | head; cat core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/CMakeLists.txt | head -60
echo "#### FreeType trig impl"; grep -n "nid_postfix\|APS5_EXPORT" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeType/src/Trigonometry.cpp | head; grep -rn "FT_Sin_nid_postfix\|FT_Tan_nid_postfix\|FT_Vector_Unit_nid_postfix" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeType --include=*.hpp
echo "#### LibcInternal iostream_category"; show '"V23qt24VPVs"' core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/InventoryExports6.cpp; grep -rn "iostream_category" core/libs/prx/libc | head
echo "#### libc __cxa_finalize"; show '"H2e8t5ScQGc"' core/libs/prx/libc/Export.cpp; grep -n -A12 "__cxa_finalize" core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/Export.cpp | head -30
echo "#### AgcVsh"; show '"LtTouSCZjHM"' core/libs/prx/libSceAgcVsh/Export.cpp; show '"pdEV7bI6COI"' core/libs/prx/libSceAgcVsh/Export.cpp; grep -n "nid_postfix" core/libs/prx/libSceAgcVsh/Export.cpp | head
echo "#### debt files"; ls docs/dev/debt | grep -i "freetype\|agc\|libc"; grep -n "FT_Sin\|Trigonometry\|forward" docs/dev/debt/libSceFreeTypeOt.md | head
echo "#### open PR overlap via git"
nums=$(for p in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pulls?state=open&per_page=100&page=$p" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;[print(x["number"]) for x in json.load(sys.stdin)]'; done)

refs=""; for n in $nums; do refs="$refs +refs/pull/$n/head:refs/pr/$n"; done
git fetch -q --depth=1 origin $refs 2>&1 | tail -3
for n in $nums; do

    echo "$d" | grep -q -- "$k" && echo "PR $n touches $k"
  done
  t=$(git diff --stat HEAD refs/pr/$n -- core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt 2>/dev/null | tail -1); [ -n "$t" ] && echo "PR $n FreeTypeOt: $t"
done
echo done
